components.name: RootLayout
components.purpose: Wraps every route with the global shell, session context provider and role-aware navigation.

components.name: Navbar
components.purpose: Shows role-specific navigation links, in-app alert count and the profile entry point.

components.name: RoleEntryPage
components.purpose: Lets a visitor pick a role and sign in with an instant synthetic demo account.

components.name: LoginPage
components.purpose: Lets a participant sign in with their email and password.

components.name: SignUpPage
components.purpose: Lets donors, NGOs, volunteers and sponsors create an account that awaits admin approval.

components.name: ForgotPasswordPage
components.purpose: Lets a participant request a password reset link by email.

components.name: ResetPasswordPage
components.purpose: Lets a participant set a new password using the token from the emailed link.

components.name: ProfilePage
components.purpose: Shows and updates the user's name, email and password, and provides sign-out.

components.name: DonorDashboardPage
components.purpose: Shows the restaurant's recent donation activity and a one-tap repeat donation action.

components.name: RestaurantPreferencesPage
components.purpose: Lets a donor save restaurant preferences while keeping safety declarations fresh for each post.

components.name: QuickPostPage
components.purpose: Lets a donor post surplus food by voice, text or manual entry and complete the handling checklist.

components.name: DonationsTrackingPage
components.purpose: Lists the donor's donations with their current status.

components.name: DonationDetailPage
components.purpose: Shows one donation's details, handling declarations and status history to anyone involved.

components.name: NgoFeedPage
components.purpose: Lists eligible nearby donations with match explanations and in-app alerts.

components.name: NgoClaimPage
components.purpose: Lets an NGO claim all or part of a donation within the confirmation window.

components.name: NgoReceiptPage
components.purpose: Lets an NGO confirm the quantity it actually received.

components.name: NgoCapacityPage
components.purpose: Lets an NGO set its current need, capacity and availability.

components.name: VolunteerTasksPage
components.purpose: Lets a volunteer toggle availability, set carrying capacity and accept pickups.

components.name: ActiveDeliveryPage
components.purpose: Lets a volunteer confirm collection and handover and see simple status updates.

components.name: AdminOperationsPage
components.purpose: Lets an admin approve or suspend participants, monitor active rescues and resolve failed assignments.

components.name: SponsorImpactPage
components.purpose: Shows CSR campaign recognition and a transparent impact dashboard with labelled assumptions.

components.name: AuthForm
components.purpose: Renders the shared email and password form used by login, signup, forgot-password and reset-password.

components.name: DonationCard
components.purpose: Summarises a donation with its status and optional match explanation across donor and NGO views.

components.name: HandlingChecklist
components.purpose: Captures the fresh per-donation handling checklist covering preparation time, storage and allergens.

components.name: StatusTimeline
components.purpose: Renders an ordered list of status events for a donation or pickup task.

boundaries: Public routes (/, /login, /signup, /forgot-password, /reset-password) must not render participant data.
Role-gated routes (donor, NGO, volunteer, admin, sponsor) are enforced server-side in route handlers and server actions, not only in the UI.
Safety declarations are per-donation and must never be copied from restaurant preferences.
Sponsor impact figures are aggregated server-side from confirmed receipts only, never from raw donor input.
Voice and AI extraction are optional; manual posting must always remain available.
Pickup and receipt state changes are written as append-only Status Events.
architecture.state_management: Server actions for all CRUD and state transitions, with React Context for session and role. Alerts and availability refresh via polling or revalidation, not a global realtime store.

flows.name: donor-post-donation
flows.summary: A donor posts surplus food by one-tap repeat, voice or typing, edits extracted values, completes the handling checklist and publishes.

flows.name: donor-track-donation
flows.summary: A donor reviews the status of each donation and opens one to see its handling declarations and status history.

flows.name: ngo-claim-donation
flows.summary: An NGO reviews eligible nearby donations with match explanations, then claims all or part of one within the confirmation window.

flows.name: ngo-confirm-receipt
flows.summary: An NGO confirms the quantity it received after a handover, which feeds the impact figures.

flows.name: volunteer-accept-and-deliver
flows.summary: A volunteer toggles availability, accepts a pickup, then confirms collection and handover on the active delivery screen.

flows.name: admin-approve-and-resolve
flows.summary: An admin approves or suspends participants, monitors active rescues and resolves failed assignments.
